basic.description:
{Basic Blood Rage}

Basic Blood Rage allows the hero's Stronghold units to accumulate up to 5 Rage Levels in combat. Each Rage Level gives bonuses to the unit's stats:

{1}: +1 Damage, {2}: +1 Attack, {3}: +1 Health, {4}: +1 Defense, {5}: +1 Speed

The bonuses of all achieved Rage Levels are cumulative. Units gain +3 Rage Levels when a buffing Warcry is cast; +2 Rage Levels when they attack; +1 Rage Levels when they take damage; -1 Rage levels when they move, and -2 Rage Levels when they take a defensive stance.

{H6 Blood Rage}
Blood Rage charge: whenever any unit on the battlefield takes damage, it gains +16 for enemy losses and +8 for friendly losses (damage over time does not count); the bar fills at 400.
At the start of each round, Blood Rage automatically activates at the level matching the number of filled charge tiers (max level II), spending that much charge:
All your H6 Stronghold units get that Blood Rage level for the round:
  Blood Rage I: +1 Speed
  Blood Rage II: +1 Speed, +2 Attack
Only affects H6 Stronghold units (they are not affected by Tears of Ashan Blood Rage).

advanced.description:
{Advanced Blood Rage}

Advanced Blood Rage allows the hero's Stronghold units to accumulate up to 10 Rage Levels in combat. Each Rage Level gives bonuses to the unit's stats:

{1}: +1 Damage, {2}: +1 Attack, {3}: +1 Health, {4}: +1 Defense, {5}: +1 Speed

{6}: +2 Damage, {7}: +2 Attack, {8}: +2 Health, {9}: +2 Defense, {10}: +2 Speed

The bonuses of all achieved Rage Levels are cumulative. Units gain +3 Rage Levels when a buffing Warcry is cast; +2 Rage Levels when they attack; +1 Rage Levels when they take damage; -1 Rage levels when they move, and -2 Rage Levels when they take a defensive stance.

{H6 Blood Rage}
Blood Rage charge: whenever any unit on the battlefield takes damage, it gains +16 for enemy losses and +8 for friendly losses (damage over time does not count); the bar fills at 400.
At the start of each round, Blood Rage automatically activates at the level matching the number of filled charge tiers (max level III), spending that much charge:
All your H6 Stronghold units get that Blood Rage level for the round:
  Blood Rage I: +1 Speed
  Blood Rage II: +1 Speed, +2 Attack
  Blood Rage III: +1 Speed, +2 Attack, 1 extra retaliation
Only affects H6 Stronghold units (they are not affected by Tears of Ashan Blood Rage).

expert.description:

{1}: +1 Damage, {2}: +1 Attack, {3}: +1 Health, {4}: +1 Defense, {5}: +1 Speed

{6}: +2 Damage, {7}: +2 Attack, {8}: +2 Health, {9}: +2 Defense, {10}: +2 Speed

{11}: +3 Damage, {12}: +3 Attack, {13}: +3 Health, {14}: +3 Defense, {15}: No enemy retaliation

The bonuses of all achieved Rage Levels are cumulative. Units gain +3 Rage Levels when a buffing Warcry is cast; +2 Rage Levels when they attack; +1 Rage Levels when they take damage; -1 Rage levels when they move, and -2 Rage Levels when they take a defensive stance.

{H6 Blood Rage}
Blood Rage charge: whenever any unit on the battlefield takes damage, it gains +16 for enemy losses and +8 for friendly losses (damage over time does not count); the bar fills at 400.
At the start of each round, Blood Rage automatically activates at the level matching the number of filled charge tiers (max level IV), spending that much charge:
All your H6 Stronghold units get that Blood Rage level for the round:
  Blood Rage I: +1 Speed
  Blood Rage II: +1 Speed, +2 Attack
  Blood Rage III: +1 Speed, +2 Attack, 1 extra retaliation
  Blood Rage IV: +2 Speed, +3 Attack, 1 extra retaliation, targets cannot retaliate
Only affects H6 Stronghold units (they are not affected by Tears of Ashan Blood Rage).
